title: Composer Mobile App Is Here, Plus 2 More Ways to Use Klaviyo AI - Klaviyo
summary: Composer, Klaviyo’s AI marketing agent, is now on iOS and Android. See what the Composer mobile app can do, then train Customer Agent and use channel affinity.
body_markdown:
Three ways to work with Klaviyo AI


Generated by Klaviyo AI


The post explains how to review and approve Composer campaigns on mobile and refine Customer Agent through plain-language feedback. It also describes how channel affinity ranks customers’ likely engagement across email, text messaging, push, and WhatsApp to inform message delivery.


-


**Mobile campaign approval:** Composer’s iOS and Android app lets users receive alerts, review campaign recommendations, request changes, and approve work before it goes live.


-


**Customer Agent training:** Users can chat with Composer inside Customer Agent to adjust responses, test fixes, and analyze performance without using Composer credits.


-


**Channel affinity rankings:** Klaviyo stores predicted channel engagement rankings on customer profiles for use in segments, flow filters, and conditional splits.


[Sign up](https://www.klaviyo.com/sign-up)[Get a demo](https://www.klaviyo.com/demo-request)


---


A campaign needs a thumbs-up while you’re out. A customer service response sounds a little too formal. A text message goes out to someone who engages more consistently with email.


[Klaviyo AI](https://www.klaviyo.com/solutions/ai) can handle each of those moments.[Composer](https://www.klaviyo.com/composer) , Klaviyo’s AI marketing agent, is now on iOS and Android, so you can approve a campaign from your phone. You can also tell Composer when a[Customer Agent](https://www.klaviyo.com/solutions/ai/customer-agent) answer sounds too formal, and it updates the agent for you. And[channel affinity](https://www.klaviyo.com/solutions/ai/what-is-channel-affinity) , which has been in Klaviyo since 2025, predicts which channel each customer is most likely to engage with, so you can lead with it.


### **1. Run Composer from your phone**


Composer is now on iOS and Android, so you can review and approve its work from your phone.


- **Get alerts on your phone.** Composer sends a notification to your phone when it finds something that needs your attention. It might flag that you’re pacing behind your Q4 goal and recommend 3 moves to close the gap. Tap “Begin the audit” to start. You can also schedule check-ins, like a weekly revenue review on Mondays at 7 a.m. that pulls from your Klaviyo and Shopify data.
- **Review campaigns from anywhere.** Ask Composer for a VIP campaign, for example, and it lays out the message and recommends an audience, channel mix, and send time, each in its own card you can tap to open.
- **Approve in one tap.** Composer stages everything for your review, and you approve it with one tap before it goes live. If something’s off, ask for changes first.
- **Understand the impact.** A growth view shows your total revenue compared with the previous period. Tabs for campaigns, flows, and benchmarks let you look closer at a time range like the last 90 days.


### **2. Train Customer Agent by describing what you want**


You can now change how Customer Agent, Klaviyo’s AI agent for customer service, sounds and responds by chatting with Composer inside Customer Agent. Ask it to train, test, or analyze your agent.


Describe a change in plain language, like telling Composer to point customers to Smile.io when they ask about loyalty points, and Composer makes the update. You can also ask Composer questions about how Customer Agent works, and it answers them.


Testing works the same way. If a Customer Agent response sounds too formal, for example, you might give it a thumbs down and tell Composer it’s too serious. Composer analyzes the conversation, your feedback, and Customer Agent’s current set-up and performance, then suggests a change that warms up the language and adds a few emojis. Keep refining the suggestion, or have Composer make the change for you.


A skill is a set of instructions that tells Customer Agent how to handle a specific task, like a return. Guidance shapes how Customer Agent communicates and when it escalates to a person, including your tone of voice and escalation rules. Knowledge is the content Customer Agent answers from, like your help articles, policies, and product details. But you don’t need to work out whether a fix belongs in skills, guidance, or knowledge. Composer picks the right place for the change.


You can also fix issues you spot in past conversations. Highlight a response, tell Composer that Customer Agent shouldn’t include prices, and it helps you make the change and test it. You go from spotting an issue to checking the fix without switching screens.


Working on Customer Agent in Composer doesn’t use Composer credits, whether you’re asking questions, training, testing, or analyzing performance.


### **3. Lead with the channel each customer prefers**


Some people more consistently click on text messages. Others pay more attention to email, push notifications, or WhatsApp.[Channel affinity](https://www.klaviyo.com/solutions/ai/what-is-channel-affinity) , Klaviyo AI’s prediction of which channel each customer is most likely to engage with, has been in Klaviyo since 2025, and it now covers WhatsApp alongside email, text messaging, and push.


Klaviyo ranks each customer’s channels and stores the ranking on their profile, so you can use it in segments, flow filters, and conditional splits.


In a price drop flow, for example, subscribers who engage most with text messaging would get the offer via text first. If they don’t respond and email is their second-ranked channel, they’d get a follow-up email. Subscribers who lean toward push would get a push notification first instead.


Channel affinity can also help with cost. Text messages cost more than email or push, so reaching people who rarely engage there adds up fast. Leading with the channel each person responds to means you spend on the costlier ones only when they’re more likely to pay off.


### **Where to start**


1. Open Composer on your phone and ask it to set up a weekly check-in on your revenue.
2. Open Composer inside Customer Agent and tell it one thing you wish Customer Agent did better.
3. Build a segment based on channel affinity, like customers who prefer email and engaged in the last 90 days, and use it in your next campaign.
